title: Incorrect total supply calculated during admin fee withdrawal
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the LT contract, when the `withdraw_admin_fees` function is called, the `_calculate_values` function is executed to recalculate all liquidity values. During this calculation, the total supply can be reduced due to a token reduction mechanism (downward rebasing) that adjusts the number of tokens based on value changes.
